gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bamum: College's rounds carry the full weight of its straight stems. Noto Sans Bamum, a modern sans, lets its curved strokes stop short of turning inward, leaving big open counters in every small letter.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuk: One thick thread, traced through every letter. College is best at dynamic, authoritative display, while Noto Sans Bhaiksuki, a plain sans, is best at staying readable through open apertures.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: College runs a flat, unswelling line along every curve, so its round letters feel as solid as its straight ones. Noto Sans Brahmi counters with a high mean line and open curves.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Steel-cable outlines, tall and unshaded: that is College in a glance. Noto Sans Buginese, a modern sans, offsets that with open letter mouths, like unjoined chalk arcs, and short ascenders.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Heavy diagonals, big counters: that is College at a glance. Noto Sans Buhid, a professional sans-serif, leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, so it sits quietly beside that weight.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham brings open, rounded lowercase with generous entry space. College, the display heading, makes its round letters as firm as its straight ones, and that firm-versus-open split is what stands out.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: College is tubular and wire-like, every curve carrying the full weight of a straight stem, with big counters. Noto Sans Lepcha, a plain sans, reads steadily, its curves staying wide.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-limbu: College looks like a skeleton outline drawn with one fixed stroke thickness, tall and open in its counters. Noto Sans Limbu, a plain sans, flows smoothly, its curves gaping wide.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Unswelling bowls and big counters: College is built to announce itself. Noto Sans Mahajani, a plain sans, does the quieter job, its tall lowercase and funnel-wide e carrying the text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-malayala: Matching crossbars and stems, tall letters: College hits hard. Noto Sans Malayalam, a sans with a dominant middle zone and an s of generous openings, takes over smoothly from there.
